imageGeneration: No image generation service was used. Stock vector art is credited as stock; custom paths were drawn in SVG code.
identificationPolicy: Companions are stylized illustrations. Only the source photo and source observation provide identification evidence. Shared type characters are explicitly marked and do not claim species-level accuracy.
